heroHeadline: Trump Renames Lake Ontario 'Lake America' as Canada Trade War Escalates, Headlines Houston Fundraiser for Paxton Senate Bid
heroSubtitle: President Trump signed an executive order Thursday, August 27, 2026 (Day 585) renaming Lake Ontario as 'Lake America,' effective immediately for federal agencies — his second renaming of an international body of water for the US after the Gulf of Mexico became the 'Gulf of America' — escalating the trade fight that followed the August 21 collapse of US-Canada talks, 50% Section 338 tariffs, Trump's August 24 threat to raise Canada auto/steel tariffs to 50% in 2027, and Canada's August 25 dollar-for-dollar retaliation on roughly $20 billion of US goods; Canadian PM Mark Carney rejected the renaming, noting Ontario's 400-year-old Indigenous name predates both nations. The same day, Trump headlined a closed-press Republican National Committee fundraiser in Houston boosting Texas Attorney General Ken Paxton's Senate campaign, and told Al Jazeera he is 'not in a hurry' to resume Iran talks and has 'no time schedule,' with Press Secretary Karoline Leavitt confirming no active negotiations are underway as Brent crude held near $87/bbl.
